subject: Request: temporary rate-tier lift, prorated billing, and usage audit evidence
messages:
From: Eric Torres <eric.torres@launchlytics.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: Sana Iqbal <procure@launchlytics.com>
Date: 2026-06-24 09:12 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — short-term QPS bump for launch week

Hi Jasmine,

Hope you're well. We're ramping a feature next week and expect a concentrated spike across four hours each day. Our current commit looks like it will throttle us during the window. Can Redwood temporarily bump our rate limit / quota for the week and do a prorated true-up on usage?

Key constraints: we need the lift to be live by Monday 29th PST, not change our long-term committed tiers, and have a simple billing reconciliation (no surprise invoices for execs). Procurement wants any change documented for PO/back-office.

I attached a short CSV showing projected token usage per hour for the spike (LL-usage-report-May.csv).

Can you advise feasibility and a blunt dollar estimate for a one-week uplift?

Thanks — Eric
Product Lead, LaunchLytics

Attachment: LL-usage-report-May.csv (CSV, 42 KB)
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Eric Torres <eric.torres@launchlytics.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-24 10:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — short-term QPS bump for launch week

Eric — thanks for the data, this is the right time window to flag. Quick summary of options so procurement can pick a path: 

1) Temporary tier bump (hours/days): we open a short-term quota lane and bill actual overrun at an elevated overage rate; we can cap the max charge and do a prorated true-up on next invoice.
2) Provisional headroom credit: we reserve capacity and apply a credit to next invoice if usage remains below the reserved amount. This is simpler for PO paperwork but requires a short-term commitment to the reserved headroom.
3) Canary fallback + rate smoothing: keep you on current tier but enable regional burst pool with automatic throttling to protect other customers — lower cost but not guaranteed sustained QPS.

If you want option 1, we need a signed addendum with effective window and max cap. I can run a rough estimate now with Ben and Karthik. Do you have a preferred hard cap on cost?

— Jasmine
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-24 11:10 -0700
Subject: RE: Quick ask — short-term QPS bump for launch week

Folks — I ran the usage CSV and modelled two price paths:

- Path A (Tier bump, prorated overrun): elevate their rate tier for the 72-hour window. Overage billed at 1.6x standard overage rate; estimated incremental = $6,400 (range $4.8k–$8.1k).
- Path B (Reserved headroom credit): reserve a headroom block at 0.9x standard rate, apply any unused portion as a credit. Incremental committed fee = $5,800 (refundable as credit if unused).

Operational notes: Path A is fastest to implement (we adjust routing + temporary quota in control plane). Path B requires a short contract addendum and finance sign-off for crediting rules. Both require documented start/end times and a two-hour maintenance window to toggle routing.

I recommend Path A with a hard invoice cap of $9k to align with their PO ask. If legal wants a simpler doc for procurement, Monica can draft the addendum template.

— Ben
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: provisional-rate-addendum.pdf (PDF, 18 KB)
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-25 09:47 -0700
Subject: RE: Quick ask — short-term QPS bump for launch week

Jasmine — I can draft an addendum that captures: exact UTC window, capped overage, prorated invoice logic, and evidence for usage (we'll attach the usage CSV and a signed acceptance). I'll include language to generate an automatic usage report (CSV + S3 link) after the window for their procurement team.

Also flagging we need to collect audit logs and request Karthik to enable detailed metering at the route/model level during the window — procurement sometimes asks for per-route token counts for PO reconciliation.

I'll prepare a PO-friendly one-page appendix and a DocuSign-ready addendum.

— Monica
Enterprise Contracts, Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, jasmine_liu@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-25 11:05 -0700
Subject: RE: Quick ask — short-term QPS bump for launch week

Done. I've enabled route-level metering and turned on high-resolution audit logs for the LaunchLytics account; logs will be stored to a temporary S3 bucket and we will provide a signed CSV export post-window. I also scheduled the control-plane change window for 2026-06-29 08:00 UTC.

Operational constraints: expect a 10–15 minute propagation delay after toggling the quota. We'll enforce the cap programmatically and emit an alarm if utilization exceeds 95% of the cap.

— Karthik
Infra Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Eric Torres <eric.torres@launchlytics.com>, Sana Iqbal <procure@launchlytics.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-26 08:31 -0700
Subject: Final proposal and next steps (option selection required)

Eric / Sana — thanks for quick responses. Proposed path based on internal ops:

- Option chosen: Temporary tier bump (Path A) with a hard cap
- Effective window: 2026-06-29 08:00 UTC to 2026-07-01 08:00 UTC
- Billing: actual overrun billed at 1.6x standard overage; invoice will include a prorated true-up for hours used within window. We will not change your long-term committed tier.
- Cap: $9,000; any consumption beyond that will trigger outreach rather than automatic bill shock.
- Evidence: post-window export (CSV) + signed addendum will be attached to the invoice.

Next steps: Sana — if Procurement can confirm PO language to reference addendum LL-2026-037-A and confirm the $9k cap, Monica will send the DocuSign link. Karthik will execute toggles as scheduled.

Attachments: provisional-rate-addendum.pdf, LL-usage-report-May.csv

— Jasmine
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Eric Torres <eric.torres@launchlytics.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: Sana Iqbal <procure@launchlytics.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-30 16:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Final proposal and next steps (option selection required)

Jasmine — we're good to proceed with the Path A proposal and $9k cap. Procurement will issue a PO referencing addendum LL-2026-037-A; Sana will route the PO and sign the DocuSign after Monica sends it. Appreciate the rapid turnaround, and please send the DocuSign link and the temporary S3 report after the window.

Thanks — Eric

Attachment: launchlytics-req-PO-2026-06.docx (DOCX, 56 KB)
